important_uncertainties: Cyprus shows early close association and human transport, not a complete proof of modern domestic status.
The grain-store → rodent → wildcat pathway is a strongly supported reconstruction, not directly observed history.
Egypt was a major later center of cat-human integration and dispersal, not the sole origin.
Much of the 2017 ancient-DNA lineage evidence follows maternal ancestry and should not be presented as the complete genome history.
Genomic selection signals do not establish a simple one-gene cause of friendliness.
The 2007 healed-fracture Hierakonpolis specimen was corrected to Felis chaus in 2008 and is not used as direct evidence for the domestic-cat lineage.
The c. 730 CE domestic cat in China is the earliest known in the current 2025/2026 study dataset, not a guaranteed permanent earliest date.
